text:
noah: Heads up — seeing p95 east-west spikes between rack-pool-3 GPU nodes during the 11:30-12:05 batching window. Affected nodes: gpu-node-312..318. Latency jumps ~30->120ms, short packet loss ~0.3-0.7%.

anika: Confirmed on console. Retransmits spike, some TCP RTOs. Traces point to fragmentation/reordering. @kai can you check NIC/counter stats?

kai: On it. Quick ethtool/ifconfig checks show RX errors on gpu-node-315 and LRO disabled on a couple hosts. Snippet:```
ethtool -S eth0 | egrep "rx_errors|rx_nohandler|tx_aborted"
rx_errors: 42
rx_nohandler: 12
tx_aborted: 0
```

sara: Reminder — we rolled a partial MTU change to enable jumbos in rack-pool-3 yesterday at ~10:45 for perf testing. Did netops finish the rollout?

netops-bot: netops-bot: MTU change scheduled and partially applied to rack-pool-3. TOR1/TOR2 set to 9000 at 10:46; TOR3 unchanged due to firmware mismatch. Rollout state: partial.

kai: That explains it — TOR3 at 1500 while TOR1/2 at 9000 causes fragmentation and RDMA fallbacks. RDMA paths are flapping and we see extra CPU and requeues. Short-term fix: make MTU consistent (downgrade TOR1/2 to 1500) or finish firmware on TOR3.

noah: We need mitigation now — can we move batch traffic off rack-pool-3 and drain GPUs? Otherwise latency SLOs are at risk and we'll start paying for retries.

anika: Killed a subset of largest batch jobs, routing canary traffic to rack-pool-4. Also toggling RDMA->TCP fallback for the affected nodes (will increase CPU but reduces packet loss).

sara: I'll coordinate rollback of the jumbo config on TOR1/TOR2 in 30m if netops agrees. Also adding a canary firmware upgrade plan for TOR3 next week (non-peak).

infra-bot: infra-bot: incident created INC-2026-1746. On-call L2 paged. Runbook: "east-west-mtu-mismatch" linked: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ew-mtu-mismatch

kai: After forcing TOR1/TOR2 back to 1500, p95 dropped to baseline within ~2 mins. Continued monitoring for 15m. Counters: rx_errors decreasing.

noah: Thanks all :thumbsup: Follow-ups — schedule firmware for TOR3, add MTU consistency check to deploy job, and add an alert for partial-jumbo-rollouts. Also note cost impact: had to shift ~20% peak load to spare racks which may show up on this month's infra spend.

anika: Agreed. I'll file a short postmortem and tag cost impact in the ticket.

sara: Taking action items: postmortem, canary plan, deploy guardrail.

noah: Closing the thread for now — reopen if anything flares up.
